import.title: Import contacts (.vcf, .csv)
import.description: Import contacts from a vCard (.vcf) or CSV file.
import.intoOrganization: Import into my organization's address book
import.intoOrganizationHint: The contacts and groups will be visible to everyone in your organization. Labels and stars are not imported.
import.error: The import failed. Please check the file and try again.
import.csvHint: Use the columns of a CSV export from this app, or a Google Contacts or Outlook export. Main columns: kind, grammatical_gender, first_name, last_name, full_name, organization, department, job_title, email_1, phone_1, address_1, website_1 (each with an optional _type column, and _2, _3… for more), notes, labels. French headers work too. Each row needs a name: a full name, a first name or a last name.
